description: This header file defines utility function prototypes for string duplication, memory management, file operations, environment variable handling, memory mapping, error handling, and randomness. It appears to be a collection of wrappers around standard system calls and library functions, intended for consistent error handling and cross-platform compatibility.

methods.name: xstrdup
methods.description: Duplicate a string with custom memory allocation, handling errors internally.

methods.name: xmalloc
methods.description: Allocate memory with error checking.

methods.name: xmallocz
methods.description: Allocate memory and zero it, similar to calloc.

methods.name: xmallocz_gently
methods.description: Allocate and zero memory, with a gentler error handling strategy.

methods.name: xmemdupz
methods.description: Duplicate memory block and zero it.

methods.name: xstrndup
methods.description: Duplicate a substring with length limit.

methods.name: xrealloc
methods.description: Reallocate memory with error checking.

methods.name: xcalloc
methods.description: Allocate memory for an array and initialize all bytes to zero.

methods.name: xsetenv
methods.description: Set an environment variable, wrapping setenv with error handling.

methods.name: xmmap
methods.description: Memory map a file with error handling.

methods.name: mmap_os_err
methods.description: Retrieve the last mmap-related error message.

methods.name: xmmap_gently
methods.description: Memory map a file with gentler error handling.

methods.name: xopen
methods.description: Open a file with error handling.

methods.name: xread

methods.name: xwrite
methods.description: Write to a file descriptor with error handling.

methods.name: xpread

methods.name: xdup
methods.description: Duplicate a file descriptor.

methods.name: xfopen
methods.description: Open a file and return a FILE pointer.

methods.name: xfdopen
methods.description: Create a FILE pointer from an existing file descriptor.

methods.name: xmkstemp
methods.description: Create a temporary file safely.

methods.name: xmkstemp_mode

methods.name: xgetcwd

methods.name: fopen_or_warn
methods.description: Open a file and warn if it fails.

methods.name: xstrncmpz
methods.description: Compare two strings up to a length, considering null termination.

methods.name: xsnprintf
methods.description: Format a string with error checking.

methods.name: xgethostname
methods.description: Retrieve host name.

methods.name: git_mkdtemp
methods.description: Create a uniquely named temporary directory.

methods.name: git_mkstemps_mode

methods.name: git_mkstemp_mode

methods.name: read_in_full

methods.name: write_in_full
methods.description: Write exactly 'count' bytes to a file descriptor.

methods.name: pread_in_full

methods.name: write_file_buf

methods.name: git_fsync
